route_id.fields: loc servicing location; drm driving miles; act 2 delivery, 5 pickup; prc.cli closest location; cst/czp state and zip; geo, vdt, pym, ver unknown
route_id.lifetime: no timestamp; a 3-day-old routeId returned the identical quote
route_id.scope: one per route (servicing location to zip code), not per car
route_id.rule: server-issued only; never built by us, even though the format is readable

notes.tracking_fields: Decision D4. Search, facets and reviews need none; quote needs analyticsData.clientId (vdp_ui); suggest needs browserCookieId and analyticsData.clientId (srp_ui). Fresh random IDs per session; never a real visitor's ID.
notes.inventory_type: Search returns vehicleInventoryType 1 or 2; availability requests send 1 as Core and 2 as Unknown (seen on an on-demand car).
notes.availability_shapes: The vehicle page sends a different availability body (no userId or sale status, clientid vdp_ui, once a capitalized VehicleLocationId). Documented in the contract; never sent by us.
notes.zip_code: The built-in browser's default location was 94087 instead of 94402; always pass the zip explicitly.
notes.access: Cloudflare returned 403 to curl for HTML pages but not for the .well-known files; plain server-side scripts are likely to be blocked.
notes.deep_links_in_apps: Carvana's apps take over only a few post-purchase pages (iOS apple-app-site-association: order pages and a Plaid redirect; Android: one order page). Vehicle and search links open in the browser.

candidate_endpoints.similar: POST /merch/search/api/v1/recommendations/personalized-recs (similar cars); recorded but no schema yet; its filters use keys outside our Filters definition

gaps: vehicle page HTML fixture, to capture in phase 3 for the vehicle_details parser
